written.myAnswer: Their reactions with oxygen become more vigorous down Group 1.
The metals become softer down the group because their increasing atomic size weakens the metallic bonding between atoms.
Potassium reacts very vigorously with halogens, forming potassium halides.
The reaction with chlorine becomes more vigorous down the group: lithium reacts on heating, sodium reacts vigorously, and potassium reacts violently.
